build_interrupt_driven_game_master: build an interrupt-driven game master prefab with entities and a memory bank using the Simultaneous engine
test_timer_expiry_feedback_loop: test the timer-to-response-to-new-timer feedback loop runs without error in the interrupt-driven game master
test_cross_entity_tag_signalling: test cross-entity tag signalling where one entity's tagged action triggers another entity's interrupt mask
test_max_ticks_termination: test that the game master terminates after a configured max_ticks limit is reached
test_simultaneous_engine_wiring: test the simultaneous engine wiring by running one step with the interrupt-driven game master and multiple entities
